# Validation performed on synthetic data

- Explicit account-dummy OLS agrees with within-chooser point estimates.
- Whole-chooser shard moments and clustered score meat reproduce an unpartitioned calculation, retaining never-granters.
- Weighted exact-hour absorption agrees with an explicit dummy regression.
- Month-boundary session carry, 15/30/60-minute breaks, strict prior same-speed counts, tied starts, and White/Black result orientation checked on independently constructed histories.
- Complete cached stages resume; altered cache content is rejected.
- Full repetition driver tested with spawn workers: 10 specifications, 100 contrasts, four primary tests, covariance files and descriptive tables successfully produced.
- Arena source manifest verified: 213 files. Main sample report authority verified against its 41,534,331-row contract.
- Projection and prefix count workers tested: stable game keys, all five speed mappings, targeted history counts and source checks.
- New Python modules compile; launcher passes bash syntax validation; IV modules import.

These checks do not constitute a run on the user's private data. The Mac run checks hashes, chronology joins, row conservation, and exact reproduction of the matched/IV baselines before accepting the corresponding new results.
